job: Approve or decline one request from an email or chat link, without signing in.
purpose: A page outside the app shell: the brand in a header band, then a reading column in a band (data-column) with the brief condensed to two parts, the reason and two commits named for their effect. The send is held for 10 seconds inline; then a done view says what is now true, with the audit ID and Undo for 15 minutes. Already answered keeps the brief and says who decided; an expired link says when it ran out and where to go.
useWhen: A decision is sent to someone by email or chat and one tap should settle it.
The person may not have a session on this device.

avoidWhen.when: The person is signed in and has several decisions waiting.
The decision needs a preview of its reach or the full evidence.
The page signs someone in or confirms an account.

states.name: done
states.how: ?state=done or ?state=declined: the done view with Undo

states.name: undone
states.how: Undo: back to the ask with an info callout
